source: Apple App Store Connect screenshot specifications; Google Play Console asset guidelines; Huawei AppGallery/AGC common requirements. Verify store requirements before a major release.

iphone-6.9.label: iPhone 6.9" / Dynamic Island (large)
iphone-6.9.notes: 1320×2868 (also accepts 1290×2796, 1260×2736). Recommended hero size; 6.3" is the minimum required size in 2026.

iphone-6.9-alt.label: iPhone 6.9" / alt 1290×2796
iphone-6.9-alt.notes: iPhone 15/16 Pro Max native size, still accepted.

iphone-6.3.label: iPhone 6.3" / Dynamic Island (medium, required)
iphone-6.3.notes: Required iPhone size in the 2026 App Store Connect specification (also accepts 1179×2556).

iphone-5.5.label: iPhone 5.5" / Home button
iphone-5.5.notes: Only needed for legacy 5.5" display coverage.

iphone-duo-outer.label: iPhone Duo / outer display screenshot
iphone-duo-outer.notes: iPhone Duo outer display screenshot. Landscape is 2034×1398 via orientation=landscape. App Preview videos use different 886×1920 dimensions.

iphone-duo-inner.label: iPhone Duo / inner display screenshot
iphone-duo-inner.notes: iPhone Duo inner display screenshot with a subtle fold crease. Landscape is 2853×2007 via orientation=landscape.

iphone-duo-preview.label: iPhone Duo / App Preview poster 886×1920
iphone-duo-preview.notes: IMPORTANT: 886×1920 (portrait) and 1920×886 (landscape) are accepted App Preview VIDEO resolutions, not screenshot sizes. This preset outputs a still poster/first-frame PNG; the App Store still requires an .mp4/.mov video for the App Preview slot.

iphone-duo-preview-landscape.label: iPhone Duo / App Preview poster 1920×886 (landscape)
iphone-duo-preview-landscape.notes: IMPORTANT: 1920×886 is an accepted App Preview VIDEO resolution, not a screenshot size. This preset outputs a still landscape poster/first-frame PNG; the App Store still requires an .mp4/.mov video for the App Preview slot.

ipad-13.label: iPad 13" / iPad Pro
ipad-13.notes: Required if the app supports iPad (also accepts 2048×2732). Use orientation=landscape for 2752×2064.

ipad-13-alt.label: iPad 13" / alt 2048×2732
ipad-13-alt.notes: Older 12.9" iPad Pro size, accepted as 13" class.

ipad-11.label: iPad 11" / iPad Pro, Air, mini
ipad-11.notes: Also accepts 1512×2316, 1668×2388, 1640×2360. Optional if 13" assets are supplied.

play-phone.label: Google Play / phone 9:16
play-phone.notes: Safe 16:9 size. Play accepts 320–3840 px with aspect ratio between 1:2 and 2:1.

play-phone-hd.label: Google Play / phone HD 1440×2560
play-phone-hd.notes: Higher-resolution 16:9 output for large listing cards.

play-tablet.label: Google Play / tablet 10"
play-tablet.notes: Portrait 10" tablet screenshot. Play also accepts landscape.

harmony-phone.label: HarmonyOS / AppGallery phone
harmony-phone.notes: Common AppGallery recommendation: 1080×1920, 3–5 screenshots, JPG/PNG, ≤5 MB. Confirm current requirements in AGC for your app category.

harmony-tablet.label: HarmonyOS / AppGallery tablet
harmony-tablet.notes: Portrait tablet asset; use orientation=landscape for 2560×1600. Confirm in AGC.
